description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade SIGEA from ASP.NET MVC 5 (.NET Framework 4.8) and Entity Framework 6 to ASP.NET Core MVC on .NET 10 with EF Core, remediate the DOTNET-SQLI-01 SQL injection and DOTNET-IDOR-01 insecure direct object reference vulnerabilities, and configure Managed Identity authentication against Azure SQL Managed Instance.
tasks.reason: The application runs on an out-of-support ASP.NET MVC 5 / .NET Framework 4.8 / EF6 stack that cannot use modern Azure SDK packages, and contains two intentional lab vulnerabilities (unparameterized SQL query and missing transcript ownership check) that must be fixed before cloud deployment.
tasks.requirements: Convert SIGEA.Web and SIGEA.Tests to SDK-style projects targeting net10.0 (Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web / Microsoft.NET.Sdk), replacing packages.config with PackageReference. Migrate the EF6 SchoolContext to EF Core, preserving the existing Table-Per-Hierarchy Person/Student/Instructor model, the CourseAssignment many-to-many join, and the OfficeAssignment shared-primary-key relationship. Replace System.Web.HttpContext.Session usage with ASP.NET Core ISession. Fix DOTNET-SQLI-01 in src/SIGEA.Web/DAL/LabQueries.cs by replacing string-concatenated SQL with a parameterized SqlCommand. Fix DOTNET-IDOR-01 in src/SIGEA.Web/Controllers/LabController.cs by enforcing an object-level ownership check so a student can only access their own transcript, consistent with TranscriptController.Details. Configure appsettings.json connection strings to authenticate to Azure SQL Managed Instance using Managed Identity (Authentication=Active Directory Managed Identity) instead of SQL username/password. Do not change unrelated business logic or existing passing behavior.

tasks.description: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate any identified vulnerabilities to ensure the application is secure before deployment. Addresses issues: SQL database connection detected, Connection strings without configuration builders detected.
tasks.reason: Ensure the modernized .NET 10 / EF Core dependency set is free of known vulnerabilities before containerization and deployment.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched version. If a CVE fix requires a major version upgrade, document the affected dependency, the current version, the upgraded major version, and the breaking change risk. Verify that the project builds and all tests pass after remediation.

tasks.description: Containerize SIGEA.Web and deploy it to Azure Container Apps using the existing infrastructure definitions in infra/azure.
tasks.reason: The user requested containerization for Azure Container Apps as the hosting target for the modernized application.
tasks.requirements: Create a multi-stage Dockerfile for SIGEA.Web (build with mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0, run with mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:10.0) listening on port 8080 as a non-root user. Build and push the container image, then deploy to the existing Azure Container Apps resources defined under infra/azure using azd/az CLI. Ensure the Container App's managed identity is used for Azure SQL Managed Instance authentication (no secrets or connection string passwords).
